decisions.question: Who is responsible for sub-MID sales and settlement?
decisions.alternative: Separately responsible sub-merchants with supported independent onboarding.
decisions.chosen: Master Merchant responsible; sub-MIDs are attributed collection units.

decisions.question: May one Personal/Household host have separate sub-MIDs under multiple Merchants?
decisions.alternative: One live Merchant sponsorship per host.
decisions.chosen: Multiple explicit relationships, each sub-MID with exactly one master.
